title: Pixel-art sci-fi hull panels with glowing lights
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art sci-fi plating module at a chosen art resolution: panels split into plates with seams and bevels, each with rivets, vent slits, a grille, a light strip, indicator lamps or hazard stripes, with metallic, emissive, normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for 2D space stations.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_scifi_panel.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: panels
parameters.meaning: Main panel cells across the tile before subdivision.

parameters.name: subdivision
parameters.meaning: Chance that a panel is split into smaller plates.

parameters.name: lights
parameters.meaning: Share of plates carrying a light strip or indicator lights.

parameters.name: vents
parameters.meaning: Share of plates carrying vent slits or a grille.

parameters.name: hazard
parameters.meaning: Share of plates painted with diagonal hazard stripes.

parameters.name: rivets
parameters.meaning: 1 puts rivets in the corners of plain plates.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and the lights in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Grey space-station plating with cyan light strips.

presets.name: clean_lab
presets.description: White laboratory panels with blue lights and few vents.

presets.name: rusty_industrial
presets.description: Dark brown industrial plating with amber lights and hazard stripes.

presets.name: alien_hull
presets.description: Violet-black alien hull with green glowing seams of light.

limits: Stylized pixel art with the light from the top left baked into the plate bevels. The module repeats on a regular panel grid aligned with the tile edges, which suits modular plating but shows the grid on large areas. Plates are rectangles split at most twice; details are fixed small patterns, and lights do not animate. Metal and glass take fixed roughness values per class. The normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Recursive rectangle splitting of a panel grid
Seam ownership on the top and left edge of each plate
Bevel shading with highlight and shadow rows
Per-plate detail selection from hashed random draws
